dataset: CASIA-FASD Kaggle extracted-image train + test evaluation (minhnh2107/casiafasd)
frame_sampling: none; all available train and test color JPEGs
combined_policy: unique (video_id,frame_index); prefer test copy before detection; no duplicate weighting
face_selection: largest positive finite bbox; confidence tie-break
secondary_unit: all successfully localized frames in the specified pool
threshold_policy: source-frozen baseline plus CASIA train-calibrated frame/video thresholds
eer_policy: descriptive ROC EER only; its target threshold is never used for predictions
threshold_objective: minimum pooled binary ACER/HTER; ties closest to source threshold
inference_precision: per-run original AMP setting; logits converted to float32 before subtraction
